memberdef.definition: using ExceptionCallback = HRESULT (*) (debug::State*, PEXCEPTION_RECORD64, ULONG firstChance)
memberdef.name: ExceptionCallback

detaileddescription.para: Implements IDebugEventCallbacksWide and IDebugOutputCallbacksWide for the dbgeng COM event model. Callbacks fire on the dbgeng thread — they store deferred flags on State and never write to stdout (main thread owns stdout).
